newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 814,800 MT were off 8 percent from the week earlier and 24 percent from the 4-week average. The primary increases were for unknown destinations (235,700 MT), Japan (162,900 MT, includes 219,500 new sales, 56,600 foreign purchases/cancellations), Saudi Arabia (71,600 MT), Portugal (65,000 MT), Spain (61,800 MT, includes 8,100 new sales, 54,000 destination changes), and South Korea (51,400 MT, includes 1,700 new sales, 52,500 destination changes).

Exports of 709,100 MT were one-third below the previous week and the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (236,000 MT), Spain (126,800 MT), Taiwan (91,900 MT), and South Korea (62,200 MT).
